title: Count and Say
description: Generate the nth term of the count-and-say sequence.

data.text: The count-and-say sequence is built by reading off the digits of the previous term, counting consecutive groups. The first term is `"1"`.

data.title: Recursion O(n * m)
Loop O(n * m)
What improved?
data.text: Iteration avoids deep recursion and stack growth. Each term is built from the previous one in a straightforward loop.
